bytesautosell.config.title: Bytes Auto Sell Settings
bytesautosell.config.sell_command.toolti: Command that opens the server's sell GUI, with or without the leading slash.
bytesautosell.config.sell_mode.tooltip: Close GUI: closes the sell GUI after depositing (server sells on close) and reopens after the delay. Keep Open: clicks the button slot to sell and keeps cycling.
bytesautosell.config.transfer_method.too: SHIFT: shift-clicks stacks into the sell GUI. PICKUP: picks stacks up with the cursor and places them into empty slots.
bytesautosell.config.button_slot.tooltip: Slot clicked to sell in Keep Open mode. Clamped into the GUI's container region on smaller GUIs.
bytesautosell.config.transfer_delay.tool: Delay in ticks between transfer steps. Lower is faster.
bytesautosell.config.transfer_burst.tool: How many item stacks are moved per transfer step. Higher is faster.
bytesautosell.config.reopen_delay.toolti: Delay in ticks between sell cycles (GUI reopen or next batch).
bytesautosell.config.randomize.tooltip: Randomizes the transfer delay between 1x and 2x the configured base for a human-like cadence.
bytesautosell.config.title_check.tooltip: Only interact with a GUI whose title exactly matches the expected title. Recommended on servers with other chest GUIs.
bytesautosell.config.expected_title.tool: Exact title the sell GUI must have when the check is enabled. A blank title matches nothing.
